title: Account access
text: A forgotten password can be reset from the account sign-in page. The recovery link expires after fifteen minutes. If the link has expired, request a new recovery email.

title: Upload troubleshooting
text: Upload error AX-409 means that the workspace storage quota is full. Remove unused files or increase the storage allowance before retrying the upload. A network timeout requires checking the connection before another attempt.

title: Project limits
text: Atlas Basic allows three active projects per workspace. Archived projects do not count toward the active-project limit. Atlas Pro allows twenty active projects per workspace.
